goal: Fix recursive skill discovery in WorkspaceController.ReadSkills and add a read-only GET api/workspace/skills/{*id} detail endpoint, then wire the Skills panel to show detail on click.
steps: 1. Rewrite ReadSkills to recursively walk .agents/skills (bounded depth) collecting every directory that directly contains a SKILL.md, using the path relative to .agents/skills (posix separators) as Id

2. Add ReadSkillDetail(repoRoot, id): validates id resolves inside .agents/skills (no path traversal), reads SKILL.md content + frontmatter, AGENTS.md if present, and a bounded recursive file listing of everything else under that skill directory
3. Add WorkspaceSkillDetail record and GET api/workspace/skills/{*id} action returning 404 if the skill id does not resolve to a real SKILL.md

4. Frontend: Skills panel items become clickable; clicking fetches /api/workspace/skills/<id> and shows the detail (raw SKILL.md content in a scrollable block, plus the file listing) inline or as a sub-view
5. Real dotnet build + npm build/lint before Checker may PASS
success_criteria: dotnet build ProjectName.slnx succeeds with 0 errors
npm run build and npm run lint both pass
GET api/workspace/skills/reasoning%2Fchain-of-thought (or equivalent route) returns real content when tested live against this repo
The reasoning/ catalog's 35 strategies appear as individual skills, not one bogus 'reasoning' entry
No path traversal possible via a crafted id (e.g. ../../secrets)
out_of_scope: Markdown rendering (raw text is fine for this pass)
grounded_in: .pmcro/design/AGENTSKILLS-IDE.md increment 2, .pmcro/queue/seed-skill-detail-view-and-nested-skills.json, trail e70fe5b4 (increment 1, establishes the WorkspaceController pattern being extended here)
